title: Ransomware preparation
story: An intruder has a copy of Nico Vega's key (operations). An old extra key for his account was put on web-01 before the restart. During the shift it removes the database archives on db-01 and ci-01, then the encrypted dump copies that still hold them, takes its commands out of auth.log on db-01, and puts an inert file on each host. Nothing is encrypted and nothing runs.
notes: Design: range/BENCH-SCENARIOS-DESIGN.md, S4. Twins T1, T3, T9, T10, T11. Limit 2: one lost copy of the archives can be repaired from the other host. Bench version 2 (2026-11-11): 200 s between the first and the second removal (it was 140 s); stage 3 is now real (the encrypted 10-minute dump copies on db-01 hold all archives, and the intruder removes them; the old stage 3, a maintenance step for the offsite copy, had no effect); a pinned session of the real Nico is open during the first removal. A defender can still repair stage 1 and 2 from a dump copy until +880.
